messages.subject: Metso growth | Mining customers, sustainability and strategic execution
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Allen,

Your Chief Growth Officer remit brings together strategy, M&A, sustainability, communications, public affairs and customer growth. That combination is highly relevant to the experience I have built from the operating side of mining.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across a major gold-mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around industrial solar and battery infrastructure and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I believe this profile can add value to Metso by bringing direct customer-side insight into how mining operators evaluate technology, sustainability, stakeholder risk and long-term partnerships, especially across emerging markets and growth jurisdictions.

I would value a conversation about where this operating experience might support Metso's Business Growth organization, regional strategy, sustainability, public affairs or strategic partnerships. My attached CV is tailored specifically to Metso.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
